quotes.speaker: Caris LeVert
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert on his trade to the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: I played many battles against Taylor in Memphis when I was in Brooklyn and Indiana.
quotes.quote: I was just training. I got a call maybe a week before that said it might be a possibility. Obviously with what they had going on over in Detroit, they had signed a few guys, so just doing the math, you knew something was going on. But coming here, I was super excited. I played many battles against Taylor in Memphis when I was in Brooklyn and Indiana. We had a couple overtime games, a lot of good battles, so I was really looking forward to playing for him as opposed to playing against him.
quotes.social_post: Caris LeVert says he was excited to join the Bucks after hearing trade rumors in Detroit. He is looking forward to playing for Taylor Jenkins after years of battling his teams as an opponent.

quotes.speaker: Caris LeVert
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert on the business of NBA trades
quotes.excerpt: As human beings, it's part of the business, but you definitely feel a certain type of way.
quotes.quote: As human beings, it's part of the business, but you definitely feel a certain type of way. But it's the business. It's fun for me. It's a new challenge to come here. Obviously we made a big trade this summer getting new pieces, so rebuilding or retooling, however you want to say it, I think we've got guys on this roster that can hopefully shock some people and win some games this year.
quotes.social_post: Caris LeVert on the Bucks roster outlook: We have guys on this team that can hopefully shock some people and win some games this year.

quotes.speaker: Caris LeVert
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert's advice to young players on development
quotes.excerpt: It's taking one day at a time. Get one percent better every day.
quotes.quote: It's taking one day at a time. Get one percent better every day. You'll look at yourself in a few months and you'll be a better player, better person. Just keep building. Take the highs with the lows. Don't get too low, stay even-keeled, and have fun with it.
quotes.social_post: Caris LeVert shares his advice for young players: Get one percent better every day. Take the highs with the lows and stay even keeled.

quotes.speaker: Caris LeVert
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert's evaluation of rookies Braden and Nate
quotes.excerpt: Braden, his team was very good, so I think he is very ready to come and contribute.
quotes.quote: Both of them have done a great job. They both played at a high level last season. Obviously Braden, his team was very good, so I think he is very ready to come and contribute right away. I think Nate has surprised a lot of people as well. I think he's making huge strides with his body. I see both of them in here each and every night working on their game, so that's definitely something you want to see with young guys.
quotes.social_post: Caris LeVert is impressed with rookies Braden and Nate: Braden is ready to contribute right away and Nate is making huge strides with his body.

quotes.speaker: Caris LeVert
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert on the team's emerging defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: Defensively, I think that's going to be our identity, pressuring, playing hard, playing competitive.
quotes.quote: Defensively, I think that's going to be our identity, pressuring, playing hard, playing competitive. That's something that Taylor has done a great job of implementing the first few days of camp, so it's on us to govern ourselves and continue that going forward for the games.
quotes.social_post: Caris LeVert says the Bucks are building a defensive identity: Our identity is going to be pressuring, playing hard, and playing competitive.

quotes.speaker: Caris LeVert
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert on the NBA's modern player development approach
quotes.excerpt: I think that's where the NBA is going nowadays. You kind of see a lot of teams doing it.
quotes.quote: I think that's where the NBA is going nowadays. You kind of see a lot of teams doing it. I think it's very advantageous. It's obviously like any other new way of doing things, players have to buy in, and I think as a player if you buy into it, you reap the benefits of it. But I think it's got to be a balance between that and just getting your reps in and seeing the ball go through the hoop. I definitely see a big advantage with it for sure.
quotes.social_post: Caris LeVert on the NBA shift toward new player development methods: If you buy into it, you reap the benefits, but there has to be a balance with getting your reps in.

quotes.speaker: Caris LeVert
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert on taking ownership of personal development
quotes.excerpt: As a player, you kind of have to take ownership of your own development.
quotes.quote: As a player, you kind of have to take ownership of your own development. You definitely have to listen to what's being said, but at the end of the day, you kind of know. From myself, I can speak for myself being in the league for 11 years now, you kind of know what it takes for you to feel good out there each and every night. You know what it takes you to get better. So it's kind of marrying that between the new constraint-led approach that the NBA is kind of going in, but I think it's great. I love doing it. I think it's competitive, and like you said, we did it in Cleveland a lot, so I'm very used to it.
quotes.social_post: Caris LeVert on his 11 years in the league: You have to take ownership of your own development. You know what it takes to feel good out there each and every night.
